title.en: MALACANANG TRANSFERRING THE PALAWAN COUNCIL FOR SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT (PCSD) FROM THE OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT TO THE DEPARTMENT OF ENVIRONMENT AND NATURAL RESOURCES

text.en:
The Palawan Council for Sustainable Development, an
attached agency of the Office of the President, is hereby transferred to the
Department of Environment and Natural Resources.
PGRA Hologram • 44760

All other rules, regulations and issuances, or parts thereof,
which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby deemed repealed or
modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 18th day of -
year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Eight.
By the President:
399110
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
PGA Hologram « 44761
